title: Perfekt with haben beyond the a1 verb set
source_title: PERFEKT WITH HABEN BEYOND THE A1 VERB SET
goal_en: Extend the familiar perfect-tense frame to the remaining regular verbs in the learning inventory; place the participle at the end, including in questions.
example: Ich habe den Vertrag geprüft.

vocabulary.note: A2-marked uses: emphasis, surprise/appreciation and a corrective qualification in interaction; beyond coordinating but.

title: Perfekt with sein
goal_en: Choose sein for common changes of place or state and bleiben; distinguish activity verbs that take haben. Learn the auxiliary with each verb.
example: Wir sind rechtzeitig umgestiegen.

title: Strong and mixed participles
goal_en: Learn the participle and auxiliary of each new strong or mixed verb as a lexical unit; recognise vowel changes and mixed forms such as gebracht and gedacht.
example: Sie hat den Termin vergessen.

title: Participles of prefixed verbs
goal_en: Contrast separable-prefix participles with inseparable be-, emp-, ent-, er-, ge-, miss-, ver-, zer- verbs; insert ge only where the verb permits it.
example: Er hat die Rechnung bezahlt und den Betrag eingetragen.

vocabulary.note: Separate existence, examination success and composition senses and their frames.

title: Participles of verbs ending in -ieren
goal_en: Form past participles without ge for verbs in -ieren; distinguish them from superficially similar verbs outside this pattern.
example: Wir haben die Heizung repariert.

title: Full präteritum paradigm of sein and haben
source_title: FULL PRÄTERITUM PARADIGM OF SEIN AND HABEN
goal_en: Extend A1 war/hatte formulas to all persons and plural forms; use these verbs naturally in past descriptions.
example: Früher wart ihr oft bei uns; damals hatten wir mehr Platz.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: davor, dahinter, danach, dafür, dagegen, daran, darüber; apply the system beyond already-known A1 fixed forms.

title: Präteritum of modal verbs
goal_en: Use konnte, musste, durfte, sollte, wollte and mochte with the correct endings and a final infinitive; keep konnte distinct from könnte.
example: Wegen des Streiks mussten wir warten.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.
Fraction meaning, beyond familiar half-hour expressions; decline halber/halbes where required.

title: Early lexical präteritum: kommen and sagen
source_title: EARLY LEXICAL PRÄTERITUM: KOMMEN AND SAGEN
goal_en: Recognise and use kam and sagte beyond fixed A1 past-tense formulas; connect a past arrival or statement to its context.
example: Sie kam später und sagte sofort Bescheid.

vocabulary.note: Fraction of a quantity, beyond the A1 quarter-hour expression.

title: Dative noun phrases
goal_en: Form dem, der, dem and den with dative nouns; add the plural dative -n where required. Transfer the pattern to new vocabulary rather than relearning A1 nominative and accusative.
example: Mit den neuen Kollegen komme ich gut zurecht.

vocabulary.note: A2-marked infinitive attribute after an indefinite expression; distinguish it from a purpose clause.

title: Expanded dative-verb government
goal_en: Go beyond familiar helfen/danken formulas: learn the case required by gefallen, fehlen, folgen, begegnen, zuhören and similar new verbs.
example: Die Erklärung hilft den Teilnehmern.

vocabulary.note: Decrease sense rather than a person/object falling.
Evaluation frame with adjective or es plus clause, beyond locating something. The A2-marked evaluation sense: give an opinion using finden plus object and adjective.

title: Full dative personal pronouns
goal_en: Use mir, dir, ihm, ihr, uns, euch, ihnen and Ihnen in new verb and preposition frames; distinguish ihr, ihnen and formal Ihnen.
example: Ich habe ihnen gestern geantwortet.

title: Verbs with dative and accusative objects
source_title: VERBS WITH DATIVE AND ACCUSATIVE OBJECTS
goal_en: Build recipient-plus-object frames with geben, schicken, zeigen, erklären and new verbs; distinguish who receives something from what is transferred.
example: Sie erklärt dem Kunden den Unterschied.

title: Order of noun and pronoun objects
source_title: ORDER OF NOUN AND PRONOUN OBJECTS
goal_en: Use the usual dative-before-accusative order for two nouns, but accusative-before-dative for two unstressed personal pronouns; place a pronoun before a full noun object.
example: Ich schicke es dir heute.

vocabulary.note: Toast use, distinct from the health noun or response to sneezing.
Named language-learning institution in the A2 word-group inventory.

title: Possessive determiners in the dative
goal_en: Extend the A1 possessive system to meinem, deiner, seinem, unseren and euren in dative phrases; retain the gender and number of the possessed noun.
example: Wir fahren mit unserem alten Wagen.

vocabulary.term: die Grundschule / die Hauptschule / die Realschule / die Gesamtschule / die Berufsschule [GROUP]
vocabulary.note: School-type family; the source names types without guaranteeing current availability everywhere.

vocabulary.term: das Gymnasium / die Volkshochschule / die Sprachenschule [GROUP]
vocabulary.note: School/adult-education types; A2 additions in the word-group section.
The A2-marked rules-for-a-building sense derived from the familiar A1 Ordnung family.

title: Productive accusative reflexive verbs
goal_en: Extend fixed A1 reflexive expressions to new verbs such as sich beeilen, sich erinnern and sich beschweren; distinguish genuinely reflexive and optional reflexive uses.
example: Ich muss mich auf die Prüfung vorbereiten.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: herhaben, herkommen, her sein, dorther, hierher.

Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: hinfahren, hinkommen, hinstellen, dorthin, hierhin.
Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.

title: Dative reflexive pronouns
goal_en: Use mir and dir when another accusative object is present; distinguish sich waschen from sich die Hände waschen and sich etwas vorstellen.
example: Ich habe mir den Arm verletzt.

vocabulary.note: A2-marked surprise/recognition use; beyond answering yes.

title: Reciprocal einander constructions
goal_en: Extend the familiar uns/sich reciprocal use to einander and preposition compounds such as miteinander, füreinander and aufeinander; distinguish reciprocal from reflexive meaning.
example: Wir helfen einander und achten aufeinander.

vocabulary.note: New regional sense of an A1 headword: motorway exit rather than departure.

title: Two-way prepositions as a case system
source_title: TWO-WAY PREPOSITIONS AS A CASE SYSTEM
goal_en: Generalise the A1 in/an patterns to an, auf, hinter, in, neben, über, unter, vor and zwischen; choose dative for location and accusative for a directed change of location.
example: Die Unterlagen liegen unter dem Tisch; ich lege sie auf den Tisch.

title: Position and placement verb contrasts
goal_en: Distinguish stehen/stellen, liegen/legen, sitzen/setzen and hängen in position versus placement meanings; connect meaning to case and auxiliary choice.
example: Ich stelle die Lampe neben das Sofa; dort steht sie besser.

title: Directional her- and hin- compounds
goal_en: Interpret direction relative to the speaker in herein/hinein, heraus/hinaus, herauf/hinauf and related forms; recognise everyday shortened forms when listening.
example: Kommen Sie bitte herein und gehen Sie dann hinauf.

title: Accusative preposition government beyond a1 formulas
source_title: ACCUSATIVE PREPOSITION GOVERNMENT BEYOND A1 FORMULAS
goal_en: Use durch, gegen, ohne, um, für and bis with new nouns and pronouns; separate temporal, local and other meanings from the fixed case rule.
example: Wir gehen durch den Park und dann um das Gebäude.

vocabulary.note: Causative and permissive bare-infinitive construction.

title: Dative preposition government beyond a1 formulas
source_title: DATIVE PREPOSITION GOVERNMENT BEYOND A1 FORMULAS
goal_en: Generalise aus, außer, bei, mit, nach, seit, von, zu and gegenüber to unfamiliar noun phrases; practise gegenüber before and after its complement.
example: Die Apotheke liegt gegenüber dem Rathaus.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: losfahren, losgehen, loslassen, geschmacklos, problemlos, wertlos; arbeitslos is an A1 prerequisite.
Occurrence/time noun; distinguish the particle mal.
Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.

title: Temporal seit, vor and in
goal_en: Distinguish an ongoing interval with seit plus present tense, a completed past distance with vor, and a future distance with in.
example: Ich wohne seit einem Jahr hier und bin vor einem Jahr eingezogen.

title: Duration and boundary preposition frames
goal_en: Contrast für, bis, bis zu, von ... bis and vom ... an; distinguish intended duration, end point and starting boundary.
example: Der Vertrag gilt vom nächsten Monat an für ein Jahr.

vocabulary.note: An event occurring after an elapsed interval, contrasted with seit, vor and in.

title: Temporal während with a noun phrase
source_title: TEMPORAL WÄHREND WITH A NOUN PHRASE
goal_en: Recognise and form während plus genitive in standard written German; understand its meaning as an interval without confusing it with the later conjunction während.
example: Während des Kurses bleibt das Handy ausgeschaltet.

vocabulary.note: Major calendar festivals; learn the usual time-preposition collocations.

title: Adjective endings after definite determiners
goal_en: Decline attributive adjectives after der/die/das and related determiners across nominative, accusative and dative; practise complete noun phrases.
example: Mit dem freundlichen Mitarbeiter war alles einfacher.

vocabulary.note: Banknote sense, distinct from a school grade.
A clothing-size step in comparisons, beyond identifying or telephone numbers.
A2-marked restrictive focus on one particular time; position determines what is excluded.

title: Adjective endings after ein-type determiners
goal_en: Decline adjectives after ein, kein and possessives; supply the grammatical ending on the adjective when the determiner lacks one.
example: Wir suchen eine günstigere Wohnung mit einem großen Balkon.

vocabulary.note: Settlement/town sense, beyond a general place or location.

title: Adjective endings without an article
goal_en: Use strong adjective endings in article-free plural and mass-noun phrases, extending rather than repeating the A1 zero article.
example: Wir bieten frisches Gemüse und günstige Getränke an.

vocabulary.note: Retirement pension rather than a guesthouse.

title: Productive comparative formation
goal_en: Extend the familiar besser/lieber/mehr set to regular and umlaut comparatives; use als to connect the comparison.
example: Diese Verbindung ist schneller, aber teurer als die andere.

vocabulary.note: Broadcasting/service sense, beyond the receiver/device.

title: Attributive comparatives and superlatives
goal_en: Add adjective endings to comparative and superlative stems; distinguish am schnellsten from der schnellste Zug.
example: Wir haben die günstigste Unterkunft gewählt.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: verkehrsreich, wortreich, regenreich.
Dress sense in the cited regional list, alongside skirt in other contexts.

title: Equality comparisons with so ... wie
goal_en: Use so/genauso/ebenso ... wie, including negated equality; keep equality distinct from comparative als.
example: Der neue Kurs ist genauso interessant wie der vorige.

title: Reason clauses with weil
goal_en: Place the finite verb at the end; use perfect and modal verb groups; connect a reason clause before or after a main clause.
example: Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil ich mich erkältet habe.

title: Real conditional clauses with wenn
goal_en: Use wenn for a realistic condition; coordinate verb-final subordinate order with main-clause inversion when the condition comes first.
example: Wenn du Zeit hast, besprechen wir den Plan.

vocabulary.note: Chair in Austrian usage; compare armchair in other contexts.
A2-marked advice frame rather than a direct instruction or obligation.

title: Repeated-time clauses with wenn
goal_en: Use wenn for repeated occasions and present/future time relations; distinguish this use from a question with wann.
example: Wenn ich Spätschicht habe, fahre ich mit dem Bus.

vocabulary.term: sonntags / montags / dienstags / mittwochs / donnerstags / freitags / samstags / sonnabends [GROUP]
vocabulary.note: Recurring-weekday adverbs.
Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.
Flush a toilet, beyond washing/rinsing dishes.

title: Content clauses with dass
goal_en: Use verb-final clauses after saying, knowing, believing and feeling; distinguish dass from the article or relative pronoun das.
example: Ich glaube, dass der Termin verschoben wurde.

vocabulary.note: A particular location/spot, beyond an employment position where that was the A1 sense.

title: Indirect yes/no questions with ob
goal_en: Embed a yes/no question after asking, knowing or checking; use final verb order without direct-question inversion.
example: Können Sie mir sagen, ob noch Plätze frei sind?

vocabulary.term: täglich / morgens / vormittags / mittags / nachmittags / abends / nachts [GROUP]
vocabulary.note: Habitual frequency/time adverbs, beyond the underlying A1 nouns.

title: Indirect w-questions
goal_en: Embed wer, was, wann, wo, wie and warum questions; preserve their meaning while changing verb position.
example: Ich weiß nicht, wann die Veranstaltung beginnt.

title: Result-linking adverbs and inversion
goal_en: Use deshalb, deswegen and daher as sentence constituents followed by the finite verb; contrast them with conjunctions such as denn and weil.
example: Der Zug fällt aus; deshalb nehmen wir einen anderen.

vocabulary.note: Apply the newly assigned verb to its clothing and carrying frames; extend to other useful collocations in a current dictionary.
The clock keeps correct/incorrect time; learn the collocation rather than relearning Uhr.

title: Reflexive verbs with fixed prepositions
goal_en: Learn a reflexive verb together with its required preposition and case; distinguish sich freuen auf/über and similar meaning changes.
example: Ich interessiere mich für den neuen Kurs.

title: Indefinite personal pronouns jemand and niemand
source_title: INDEFINITE PERSONAL PRONOUNS JEMAND AND NIEMAND
goal_en: Use someone/no one as subject or object; recognise jemanden/jemandem and niemanden/niemandem; keep person reference separate from etwas/nichts.
example: Hat jemand mit den Nachbarn gesprochen? Nein, niemand.

title: Substitution with welcher and indefinite welche
source_title: SUBSTITUTION WITH WELCHER AND INDEFINITE WELCHE
goal_en: Replace an already named noun with an appropriately inflected pronoun; distinguish an identifying question from an indefinite quantity.
example: Wir brauchen Schrauben. Hast du welche?

vocabulary.note: Source word-family members: das Video / der Videofilm, das Videogerät, die Videokassette, der Videorekorder. Legacy-media contexts have lower study priority. Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.

Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: vollautomatisch, vollversichert, halb voll, hoffnungsvoll, sorgenvoll, wertvoll, die Vollmilch, der Vollmond.
Temporal origin/source in a noun-related phrase, beyond person/place origin.

title: Polite konjunktiv ii beyond memorised formulas
source_title: POLITE KONJUNKTIV II BEYOND MEMORISED FORMULAS
goal_en: Extend A1 möchte/würde formulas to hätte, wäre and könnte; form your own polite requests and tentative preferences.
example: Könnten Sie mir einen späteren Termin anbieten?

title: Fractions and partitive quantity nouns
goal_en: Use ein Drittel, ein Viertel and die Hälfte with the correct noun/partitive phrase; distinguish quantity from an ordinal rank or a time-of-day expression.
example: Ein Drittel der Teilnehmer hat schon geantwortet.

vocabulary.note: A2-marked future use with infinitive, beyond lexical become/change of state.

Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: wiedergeben, wiederkommen, wieder treffen.

title: Recurring-time adverbs
goal_en: Form and use weekdays and times of day in -s, and recurring-time forms such as täglich and werktags; distinguish a particular day from a recurring pattern.
example: Dienstags arbeite ich vormittags, samstags dagegen abends.

vocabulary.note: Regular-day frequency, rather than naming a particular weekday.
Ask for the source of someone's knowledge, beyond physical origin.

title: Repetition-count expressions
goal_en: Extend familiar einmal to productive zweimal, dreimal and other -mal counts; contrast frequency per interval with a one-off past count.
example: Ich habe zweimal angerufen und komme dreimal pro Woche zum Kurs.

title: Multiplicative -fach forms
goal_en: Use zweifach, dreifach and related multiplicative forms; distinguish einfach meaning single/simple from the adjective easy; decode the double or triple size/quantity.
example: Die Menge ist jetzt dreifach so groß.

title: Enumeration adverbs
goal_en: Use erstens, zweitens, drittens and related -tens forms to organise reasons or steps; distinguish them from first/second as adjective attributes.
example: Erstens ist der Weg kürzer; zweitens sparen wir Geld.

title: Ordinal adjectives beyond a1 date formulas
source_title: ORDINAL ADJECTIVES BEYOND A1 DATE FORMULAS
goal_en: Decline ranking and sequence adjectives in new cases and attributive phrases; extend known date ordinals to larger ranks and ordered descriptions.
example: Mit dem dritten Vorschlag bin ich einverstanden.

vocabulary.note: Learn acceptance and assumption senses, with their complement patterns.

title: Productive genitive noun phrases
goal_en: Extend A1 recognition of genitive to forming masculine/neuter -(e)s, feminine and plural genitive phrases; distinguish possession, membership and part-whole relations.
example: Die Öffnungszeiten des neuen Geschäfts haben sich geändert.

vocabulary.note: Regional workplace prepositional frame, beyond the A1 local auf pattern.
Distinct action senses with the same verb; learn each frame.

title: Prepositions of bounds and substitution
goal_en: Use innerhalb/außerhalb plus genitive and statt/anstatt plus a noun phrase; recognise regional dative variants without adopting them as the default formal written model.
example: Innerhalb einer Woche erhalten Sie statt des Originals eine Kopie.

vocabulary.note: Source office title; apply nominalised-adjective declension.
Agreement/arrangement sense, beyond A1 switching off.

title: Weak masculine noun declension
goal_en: Use -(e)n outside nominative singular with nouns such as der Kunde, Kollege, Mensch and Zeuge; learn exceptions and the mixed pattern of Name.
example: Ich habe mit dem neuen Kollegen und dem Zeugen gesprochen.

vocabulary.note: Appearance-based assessment with a clause, beyond basic visual description.
Bench sense, distinct from the A1 financial-institution sense where not already mastered.

title: Nominalised adjective declension
goal_en: Use adjective endings when an adjective denotes a person or thing: ein Bekannter, die Angestellte, etwas Neues; retain capitalisation.
example: Eine Bekannte hat mir etwas Wichtiges erzählt.

title: Standalone demonstrative pronouns
goal_en: Use der/die/das and dieser as anaphoric pronouns with the required case; distinguish stressed demonstrative reference from an article.
example: Den dort kenne ich; mit dem habe ich gearbeitet.

title: Standalone possessive pronouns
goal_en: Distinguish mein Buch from meines/meins; decline possessive pronouns when the noun is omitted.
example: Ist das dein Werkzeug? Nein, meines liegt zu Hause.

vocabulary.note: Pass on greetings/a message, beyond ordering goods.

title: Identity and type determiners
goal_en: Use derselbe/dieselbe/dasselbe, solcher and jener; distinguish the same individual object from an object of the same kind.
example: Wir haben denselben Kurs besucht, aber solche Aufgaben noch nie gesehen.

title: Indefinite quantifier declension
goal_en: Use jeder, mancher, mehrere, einige, viele and wenige as determiners or pronouns; select singular/plural agreement and adjective endings.
example: Jeder Teilnehmer bekommt mehrere nützliche Hinweise.

title: The irgend- system
goal_en: Form and understand irgendein, irgendjemand, irgendetwas, irgendwo, irgendwann and irgendwie; distinguish lack of specificity from a known person or thing.
example: Irgendjemand hat die Unterlagen irgendwo abgelegt.

vocabulary.note: Resultative frame rather than literal transport.

title: Extended negative pronouns and quantifiers
goal_en: Use keiner, niemand, nichts, gar nichts, überhaupt kein and nicht mehr with appropriate case; distinguish not any, not yet and no longer.
example: Keiner der Teilnehmer hat überhaupt etwas bemerkt.

vocabulary.note: Municipal office title; extend the main-list masculine form to the feminine.

Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: das Bundesland, die Bundesregierung, der Bundesminister, die Bundesstraße.
Office title and its feminine form.

title: Postnominal prepositional and adverbial attributes
goal_en: Expand noun phrases with identifying information after the noun; distinguish an attribute from an adverbial describing the whole event.
example: Die Wohnung über der Apotheke ist frei.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: dabeibleiben, dabeihaben, dabei sein.

title: Agreement in expanded noun phrases
goal_en: Maintain article, adjective, noun and pronoun agreement through longer descriptions, coordination and genitive attributes; focus on the head noun.
example: Mit den beiden neuen Kollegen meiner Schwester arbeite ich gern.

vocabulary.note: Read quantities written as dl.

title: Degree and focus particles
goal_en: Use ziemlich, besonders, ganz, völlig, nur, sogar, auch and erst in their modifying positions; recognise changes in scope.
example: Sogar der neue Mitarbeiter hat die Aufgabe völlig selbstständig gelöst.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: das Doppelbett; Doppelzimmer is already in the A1 baseline.
Regional keyboard/key usage, beyond ordinary physical pressing.
Physical pressure and discomfort senses in context.

title: Quantity limits and partitive expressions
goal_en: Use mindestens, höchstens, fast alle, eine Menge, ein Teil and die Hälfte with appropriate agreement and complements.
example: Höchstens die Hälfte der Bewerber hat bisher geantwortet.

vocabulary.note: Regional form/gender contrast of an A1 location noun.
Fraction noun; practise singular/plural and a partitive complement.
Multiplicity meaning of -fach, beyond einfach meaning easy; continue the pattern.

title: Verb-preposition frames with accusative
goal_en: Learn denken an, warten auf, sich bewerben um and other source verbs as whole frames; distinguish fixed prepositions from free place phrases.
example: Sie bewirbt sich um eine Stelle bei einem Verlag.

vocabulary.note: Keep deployment, employment and adjustment senses in separate examples.

Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: das Einzelkind, das Einzelteil; Einzelzimmer is already in the A1 baseline.
Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.

title: Verb-preposition frames with dative
goal_en: Learn teilnehmen an, sprechen mit/von, bestehen aus and other required frames; preserve the preposition when replacing its complement.
example: Ich nehme an einer Weiterbildung teil.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: das Elektrogeschäft, der Elektroingenieur, der Elektrokocher, der Elektroherd.
Regional neuter gender for an A1 headword; ordinary production alternative: die E-Mail.

title: Two-preposition verb frames
goal_en: Use paired complements such as sich bei jemandem für etwas bedanken and mit jemandem über etwas sprechen; preserve both government patterns.
example: Ich bedanke mich bei Ihnen für Ihre Unterstützung.

vocabulary.note: Learn/find out, distinguished from the adjective experienced.

title: Adjective complement government
goal_en: Learn zufrieden mit, interessiert an, stolz auf, ähnlich plus dative and other adjective frames; recognise uncommon genitive complements without prioritising their production.
example: Ich bin mit dem Ergebnis zufrieden und auf meine Fortschritte stolz.

vocabulary.note: Enumeration adverbs; continue the pattern for larger numbers.

title: Preposition plus interrogative pronoun for people
source_title: PREPOSITION PLUS INTERROGATIVE PRONOUN FOR PEOPLE
goal_en: Ask mit wem, für wen, an wen and related questions; retain the case required by the verb or preposition.
example: Mit wem hast du über den Vertrag gesprochen?

vocabulary.note: Regional occasional-frequency sense, distinct from approximately.
Institution name and abbreviation.
Higher-education institution type.

title: Da-compounds as a productive reference system
source_title: DA-COMPOUNDS AS A PRODUCTIVE REFERENCE SYSTEM
goal_en: Extend fixed A1 vocabulary to systematic darauf, daran, damit, darüber and related forms for things or propositions; distinguish person reference.
example: Ich warte auf die Antwort und denke ständig daran.

vocabulary.note: Regional festival names; recognise their shared reference.
Exhausted, beyond finished/ready in the A1 baseline.

title: Wo-compounds for questions about things
goal_en: Form worauf, woran, womit, wofür and worüber; insert r before a vowel; distinguish wofür from für wen.
example: Worüber habt ihr euch beschwert?

title: Zu-infinitives after verbs
goal_en: Use versuchen, hoffen, vergessen, beschließen and other verbs with zu-infinitives; place zu inside separable verbs and omit it after modal verbs.
example: Ich habe vergessen, den Antrag abzuschicken.

vocabulary.term: Frankreich / der Franzose / die Französin / französisch [GROUP]
vocabulary.note: The source's additional country/nationality family; use n-declension for Franzose.

title: Zu-infinitives after adjectives and es expressions
source_title: ZU-INFINITIVES AFTER ADJECTIVES AND ES EXPRESSIONS
goal_en: Use es ist wichtig/möglich/schön and similar frames; distinguish the introductory es from the logical subject of the action.
example: Es ist wichtig, den Vertrag sorgfältig zu lesen.

title: Zu-infinitives after nouns
goal_en: Expand Absicht, Möglichkeit, Zeit, Lust and similar nouns with an infinitive clause; distinguish a noun complement from a purpose clause.
example: Ich habe die Möglichkeit, meine Arbeitszeit zu ändern.

vocabulary.note: Functioning and topic frames, beyond movement.

title: Subject clauses
goal_en: Use a dass-, W- or infinitive clause as the subject; understand its relationship to a version with introductory es and keep singular agreement.
example: Dass du rechtzeitig Bescheid gesagt hast, hat uns geholfen.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word. Explicit source-family members to learn: das Gesamtgewicht, die Gesamtsumme.

title: Ohne ... zu clauses
goal_en: Express an omitted accompanying action when the logical subject is shared; keep the infinitive group distinct from ohne plus a noun.
example: Er ist gegangen, ohne sich zu verabschieden.

vocabulary.note: Source word-family head: learn the meaning pattern and interpret relevant compounds; not an isolated inflected word.

title: Statt ... zu clauses
goal_en: Express an unused alternative with a shared logical subject; distinguish statt plus infinitive from statt plus noun phrase.
example: Sie fährt mit dem Rad, statt das Auto zu nehmen.
